description:

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários. Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

  • Acompanhar a execução de campanhas de mídia paga (Google, Meta, LinkedIn etc.), garantindo desempenho alinhado às metas de aquisição, alcance ou conversão;

  • Formação superior completa em Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas de mídia paga: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads e LinkedIn Ads, além de parceiros de mídia programática;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas de mensuração e dados, como GA4, DV360 e Adobe CDP;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint e Word);

title: Executivo de Contas - Rio de Janeiro, BRA
description:
Quem somos

A CloudKitchens apoia donos de restaurantes em todo o mundo a terem sucesso no delivery online. Nosso objetivo é tornar a alimentação mais acessível, conveniente e de alta qualidade para todos.

Transformamos propriedades subutilizadas em cozinhas inteligentes (smart kitchens), permitindo que restaurantes atendam melhor seus clientes e contribuam positivamente para as comunidades onde estão inseridos. Sempre que inauguramos uma nova unidade, geramos empregos locais e temos orgulho de oferecer uma ampla variedade de culinárias e opções de alimentação saudável a preços acessíveis.

Estamos revolucionando o setor gastronômico, atendendo desde empreendedores que estão iniciando seu primeiro negócio até grandes redes globais de fast food.

O que você irá fazer

  • Atuar como consultor de confiança: construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes em potencial e apoiá-los na expansão de seus negócios por meio das soluções de delivery otimizadas da CloudKitchens.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas: desde o primeiro contato (inbound) até o fechamento do contrato, sendo responsável por todas as etapas do processo comercial.
  • Nutrir leads: acompanhar os prospects ao longo de todo o funil de vendas, garantindo que suas necessidades sejam atendidas e esclarecendo eventuais dúvidas.
  • Superar expectativas de desempenho: cumprir e exceder metas e indicadores-chave de performance (KPIs).
  • Desenvolver sua carreira: tornar-se especialista em princípios, processos e melhores práticas de vendas, investindo em uma carreira sólida e de longo prazo na CloudKitchens.

O que estamos buscando

  • Experiência em vendas: entre 2 e 3 anos de atuação em vendas de ciclo completo (full-cycle), em funções com metas claras e histórico comprovado de alcance e superação de objetivos.
  • Habilidades de venda consultiva: perfil analítico, curiosidade intelectual e forte capacidade de negociação e fechamento.
  • Comunicação eficaz: excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, tanto presencialmente quanto por telefone.
  • Orientação para resultados: foco consistente em metas e convicção de que a disciplina nas atividades diárias, semanais e mensais conduz ao sucesso.
  • Ética de trabalho: forte senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento e motivação para alcançar alta performance. Perfil dinâmico, competitivo e orientado à excelência.
  • Observação: esta posição exige atuação integral em português. No entanto, a proficiência em inglês será considerada um diferencial.

Por que se juntar a nós?

  • Crescimento exponencial do mercado: a demanda por delivery online cresce aceleradamente. Nos últimos cinco anos, somente nos Estados Unidos, o mercado expandiu dez vezes (de US$ 10 bilhões para US$ 100 bilhões) e pode atingir entre US$ 500 bilhões e US$ 1 trilhão até 2030.
  • Transformação do setor: você fará parte de uma equipe que impulsiona o sucesso de restaurantes na era digital.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: contará com o apoio de colegas e líderes experientes, trabalhando de forma integrada com diferentes áreas para garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

Informações adicionais

Esta posição é baseada em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro. Como uma empresa orientada pela inovação e pela evolução contínua, valorizamos a colaboração presencial. Estamos constantemente reinventando nossa indústria, desenvolvendo novos produtos e aprimorando processos — e acreditamos que nossos melhores resultados acontecem quando trabalhamos juntos. Por isso, nossas equipes atuam presencialmente cinco dias por semana.

Pronto para se juntar a nós enquanto apoiamos aqueles que servem aos outros?

Mídias Digitais e Redes Sociais Institucionais

  • Criar e adaptar conceitos visuais e desdobrar peças para campanhas de comunicação internas e externas, on e offline, considerando diferentes públicos e contextos.
  • Garantir coerência entre identidade visual, mensagem e estratégia institucional.

  • Criar peças visuais de apoio para eventos, feiras e apresentações institucionais.
  • Adequar identidades visuais para diferentes formatos e demandas.

Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.


For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.


Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.


By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

  • Curious – we turn knowledge into action

We are looking for a senior executive (Director) to join our Upstream research team. Our oil and gas sector teams are located around the world and deliver research and consulting projects based on our assessment and valuation of thousands of individual assets. Together, we work with a range of clients, including national and major oil companies, operators, investment banks, and institutional investors.

Role Purpose

  • To contribute to the strategic priorities and objectives of your region/sector/specialist area

  • To support junior and middle managers in delivering excellence in overall team performance
  • To help recruit, develop and retain the right people and establish open, supportive and dynamic team environments which deliver success
  • To collaborate effectively with commercial colleagues in Latin America to build a more lucrative business in the region
  • To be accountable for delivering industry leading Upstream research
  • To be accountable for your team collaborating effectively with other sectors/specialist areas, such that there is close alignment on cross-team or pan-sectoral issues, and client expectations are addressed

Key Responsibilities

  • Contributes to strategic planning and decision-making within business area, ensuring that programmes and objectives are aligned with strategic goals

  • To contribute to our regional and global thought leadership research efforts

About you

  • MSc or equivalent level qualification

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the oil and gas markets of the Latin America region

  • Deep experience in stakeholder engagement and management
  • Strong blend of technical skills and experience and demonstrable commercial acumen
  • A track record in demonstrating differentiated values and behaviours
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrable curiosity with a track record of impactful innovation
  • Excellent data reading, manipulation and analysis skills.

Expectations

  • We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be required to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. Full-time remote working is not an option for this role.

At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting‑edge AI models. Organization : Alignerr Position : Oncology Clinical Researcher Type : Hourly Contract Compensation : $40–$80 /hour Location : Remote Commitment : 10–40 hours/week

  • Experience designing and managing oncology clinical trials from protocol development through data readout.

  • Familiarity with regulatory submission standards for agencies such as the FDA or EMA.

Preferred

  • Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Work directly on frontier AI systems transforming cancer research.
  • Influence how AI models understand and reason about real oncology data.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.

title: Workday Release and Adoption Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Workday Release and Adoption Manager is responsible for managing the technical and organizational aspects of Workday releases, driving user adoption, and supporting continuous improvement of Workday functionality across the organization. This role serves as the central point of coordination for release management, change communication, training and support, regression testing, and operational governance. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, deep Workday expertise, and a passion for driving organizational excellence through effective systems management and user enablement.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday release management and feature adoption. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional area requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Workday Community and Functional Area Self‑Service Support – Support organizational capability building and issue resolution
    • Manage Community user access and profiles
      • Work with HR and ETS to deactivate users no longer employed with the organization
      • Connect users to appropriate Community resources and documentation
    • Support submission of ideas to Ideation Hub to encourage Workday product development and new functionality
    • Support cross‑functional teams in continuous improvement efforts
    • Identify problems from recurrent issues and lead resolution efforts by coordinating resources
    • Oversee and manage escalated issue resolution
      • Manage Workday Support Cases and Ask‑an‑Expert tickets
      • Escalate issues as needed to ensure resolution
      • Ensure functional area operational continuity
  • Manage incidents and service requests
    • Report on and elevate tickets across all systems (Workday Help Cases, Request Framework, Security Requests, ServiceNow, other tools)
    • Ensure timely tracking and resolution
    • Generate and manage updates to Workday Help Articles for accuracy and relevance
  • Tenant Management – Manage non‑production Workday environments
    • Manage refresh schedules, refresh requests, and coordinate tenant refreshes for non‑production tenants
    • Maintain activity logs for each tenant
    • Communicate tenant refresh schedules and impacts to stakeholders
  • Releases and Regression Testing – Lead Workday release management and testing coordination
    • Log and disseminate all relevant weekly release notes and manage bi‑annual releases utilizing tools in Community, Adoption Planning, and Kainos SmartTest
    • Work with functional areas to ensure awareness of release information, including:
      • Release item notes and documentation
      • Testing coordination (responsibilities, timeframes, tenant refreshes)
      • Workday Support Case resolution and completion tracking
    • Support functional area learning of new functionality by connecting them with Workday Community resources
    • Support functional areas in regression and configuration testing of new functionality being implemented
      • Test planning, scenario development, and execution
      • Issue log management and resolution tracking
      • Completion verification and sign‑off
      • Research and champion new and emerging Workday functionality
      • Perform basic report writing and collaborate with report writers to identify exceptions and testing requirements
    • Operational Meetings and Support – Maintain operational governance and cross‑functional coordination
      • Build and maintain strong relationships with all functional area stakeholders
      • Meet regularly with operational areas to address issues and concerns
      • Prepare meeting agendas, materials, and action item tracking
      • Disseminate release updates and technical information that may impact operations
      • Support feature adoption
        • Assist with planning, scheduling, and coordination
        • Support status tracking and reporting
        • Coordinate cross‑functional engagement to manage feature impacts
        • Monitor effective and timely delivery
        • Identify and escape risks and issues
    • Change Log Management – Maintain comprehensive records of Workday changes
      • Document configuration changes and enhancements
      • Maintain change logs with implementation dates and responsible parties
      • Track configuration versions across all tenants
      • Communicate change history to stakeholders and functional area leads
      • Support audit and compliance reporting on system changes
    • Training and Support – Facilitate user enablement and continuous learning
      • Provide references to Workday Community Resources, such as user guides, quick reference materials, and training videos, for new and enhanced functionality
      • Manage Adoption Planning in Workday and collaborate with business units on release and feature adoption

    Core Competencies

    • Excellent communication skills and ability to build and maintain strong relationships; ability to convey complex technical information to non‑technical audiences
    • Possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail and ability to document
    • Passion for continuous improvement and proactive problem‑solving and ability to manage complex change processes
    • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, accurately collect information, assess situations, and then translate them into technical requirements
    • Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
    • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in identifying helpful solutions and driving cross‑functional alignment
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
    • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data

    Minimum Requirements

    • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
    • Minimum 3 years of professional Workday experience with demonstrated expertise in system administration and best practices
    • Experience managing multiple bi‑annual or more frequent release cycles
    • Experience with change management and organizational adoption strategies
    • Proven ability to adhere to and promote Workday best practice methodologies across the organization
    • Basic report writing capabilities in Workday; ability to develop and modify standard reports
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Office productivity suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
    • Strong knowledge of Workday release and tenant management processes
    • Deep familiarity with Workday Community resources, including Workday Success Plans and self‑service materials
    • Knowledge of Workday Help – Cases and Articles functionality
    • Familiarity with ITSM tools and ticketing systems (ServiceNow or similar)

    Expected Salary Range: $85,000 - $100,000

title: Software Engineer - Cloud Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to work on Linux, cloud infrastructure, pipelines and automation, and open source software.

You will work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to make Ubuntu the best platform there is in the clouds. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

What the role entails

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Design, build and integrate new features and enhancements into Ubuntu that will support users of Ubuntu in public clouds
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Design and architect complex new systems and integrations with the clouds
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have practical experience with public clouds
  • You have interest and experience with at least 3 of the following: containers (docker, kubernetes, etc.), devops automation, open source projects, APIs, Linux systems administration, Python packaging, cloud-based applications
  • at least experience in Python software development on Linux

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast‑paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area‑related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements.
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies.
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles.
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed.
  • Participate in scheduled and ad‑hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Expected Salary Range

$110,000 - $125,000

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releasees and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross-functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow-up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. Job Overview And Responsibilities

This position is responsible for the operation of machinery that performs machining in metallic structures. Planning, turning, drilling, and grinding are examples of machinery processes that are part of the work scope under the Machinery Technician responsibility.

  • Works on machinery workshop handling all machining process to support aircraft maintenance heavy check
  • Fabrication, grinding and repair of metal structures is part of the regular job accountabilities
  • Operate lathe machine and measure work pieces verifying dimensions using appropriate tools

  • Operate lifting devices for movement of materials and other equipment as needed
  • Be familiar with the preparation of tools for machining
  • Load feed mechanism by lifting stock into position
  • Maintain specifications by observing drilling, grooving, and cutting, including turning, facing, and threading

  • Verify settings by measuring positions, first-run parts, and sample work pieces

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent in Machining Operation technical course with emphasis in planning, turning, drilling, and grinding

  • Must be legally authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship

  • 3 years’ experience in aeronautical industry
  • Must have extensive knowledge of machinery operation with emphasis on the aeronautical industry
  • Must have experience operating lathe machine, milling machine, vertical and horizontal band saw, drill and tread machine, hydraulic press and oven operation for heat treatment

  • Must be able to read a tape measure, verify dimensions, use a straightedge and other measuring devices
  • Have the knowledge of machine drawings, fit and tolerances
  • Must be able to operate lifting devices
  • Must be able to read and understand work instructions, drawings, technical manuals and standards in English.
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

title: Global Head of GSI Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new senior leadership role, Head of Global System Integrator (GSI) Alliances, to lead our business development and partnership with these important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we are expanding into the enterprise market where GSIs provide significant operational and tactical capacity. We have had good success with GSIs that are delivering next‑generation private cloud, container, and public cloud solutions built with Canonical Ubuntu, and are looking to expand our investment in these alliances.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Global Head of GSI Alliances will lead a team of representatives and develop that strategic go‑to‑market strength for Canonical. You will work closely with GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open‑source solutions at scale for their enterprise customers. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that our solutions are used or embedded at the core of GSI digital transformation platforms.

Our GSI team builds trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increases Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizes the partnership and leads all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. The Global Head of GSI Alliances will own the strategy, sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with all GSI partners, as well as promotion of our GSI‑related activities – from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and GSI‑related events (including Canonical's yearly GSI executive summit).

Location: Our company largely works from home; this role can be based in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Own and drive GSI partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical
  • Lead and evolve a team towards accelerated revenue growth with GSI
  • Build strategic relationships with partners at executive levels
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance and indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in the GSI sector
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue and margins
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu and Canonical's competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data‑driven decision‑making
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Por que a AstraZeneca?

Na AstraZeneca, valorizamos a inovação e o pensamento empreendedor. Trabalhamos para redefinir o cuidado ao paciente, combinando ciência de ponta com estratégia para alcançar objetivos ambiciosos. title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Engineer - Silicon Enablement
description:
Ubuntu Linux, already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, is looking to increase its adoption even further by expanding the number of System On Chip (SoC) platforms supported natively and further optimising to ensure the highest performant experience for all users. There is a strong demand from silicon manufacturers such as NVIDIA, Xilinx, MediaTek, and Qualcomm to provide Ubuntu Linux to their customers and Canonical is looking to broaden its silicon enablement squads to meet this challenge. The Canonical Kernel Team - those responsible for the build, maintenance, and distribution of the Linux kernel for Ubuntu - are looking for individuals with a strong flair for software development at the hardware level and a passion for ensuring the most optimal performance the silicon can provide.

The successful candidate will be able to prove a strong aptitude for software engineering at the hardware level. While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be a substantial advantage, it is not a hard requirement for candidates with prior background in other RTOS' or bare-metal environments as long as direct hardware experience can be demonstrated.

There are a number of work-from-home based roles available worldwide and we are looking for experience levels from early career candidates with a couple of years under their belt up through senior industry veterans.

What your day will look like

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with our silicon vendor partners to integrate their platform support into the Ubuntu Linux kernel for their product ranges
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by partners, customers, the community at large, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take responsibility for the delivery of distinct silicon-optimised variants of the Ubuntu Linux kernel to the world
  • Improve tooling and automation for the delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers
  • Identify new means of maximising performance on partner silicon

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organised and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Significant programming ability in C
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other aspects of hardware-level system engineering
  • Solid background with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior background with the major SoC families
  • Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with Linux kernel patching and debugging
  • Solid understanding of performance optimisation for silicon platforms

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Home-based work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About Retrouvai

Retrouvai ( is a globally recognized luxury fine jewelry brand based in Los Angeles known for bold design, exceptional gemstones, and modern heirlooms. Our pieces are worn by leading celebrities and sold through premier retailers and luxury destinations worldwide, including Paris, London, Dubai, and Morocco.

We are a founder‑led, design‑driven company experiencing strong growth. As we scale, we are building a disciplined financial infrastructure to support long‑term success.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Accountant to take full ownership of our accounting function (remote).

This is not a support role.

You will be the sole accounting resource for the company, responsible for maintaining clean, accurate books and ensuring the financial foundation of the business is strong, organized, and reliable.

You will work directly with the founders and have full visibility into the financial operations of a global luxury brand.

What You Will Own

You will be responsible for managing the entire accounting function, including:

Core Accounting

  • Maintain the general ledger in QuickBooks Online
  • Record all financial transactions accurately and on time
  • Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and vendor payments
  • Manage Accounts Receivable (AR), including invoicing and collections

Monthly Close & Reporting

  • Own and execute the monthly close process
  • Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
  • Deliver a clean monthly reporting package to leadership
  • Identify and explain key financial trends and variances

Payroll & Compliance

  • Manage payroll through QuickBooks Online / Gusto
  • Ensure payroll taxes and filings are completed accurately and on time
  • Support onboarding/offboarding from an HR and payroll perspective

Inventory & Cost Accounting (Important)

  • Maintain accurate inventory accounting (raw materials, WIP, finished goods)
  • Track cost of goods sold (COGS) and gross margins
  • Ensure proper flow of costs through inventory to financial statements

Systems & Process Ownership

  • Establish and maintain clean, scalable accounting processes
  • Improve workflows and introduce automation where appropriate
  • Coordinate with external CPA for year‑end tax filings

What We're Looking For

This role requires someone who can operate independently and take full ownership.

Required

  • 5+ years of accounting or full‑charge bookkeeping experience
  • Strong experience with QuickBooks Online
  • Experience managing full monthly close independently
  • Hands‑on experience with AR, AP, and reconciliations
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to communicate clearly in English (written and verbal)

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with inventory‑based or product businesses
  • Experience managing accounting as the sole or primary accountant
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies
  • Background in public accounting or CPA track

What Success Looks Like

  • Books are clean, accurate, and always up to date
  • Monthly close is completed on time without supervision
  • Financial reports are clear, organized, and insightful
  • AR is actively managed and collections are followed up consistently
  • Founders have confidence in the financials without needing to dig

Compensation

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Performance‑based bonus tied to accuracy, timeliness, and financial operations
  • Fully remote role with flexibility

description:
Engenheiro de Poços - Híbrido - Macaé - RJ

Brazil - Rio de Janeiro

  • 3 anos de experiência na área de planejamento e/ou acompanhamento da construção, abandono ou workover de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de simulação para análise de risco tais como : Well Cost Deterministic Pkg e Well Cost Advanced Pkg ou Genesis PFU (Completions Planning and Follow-up), Genesis Drilling e Genesis IVAC.
  • Na parte de Dados : Tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística e árvore de decisão.
  • Pacote Office : Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa.
  • Nível de Formação: Superior em Engenharia, devidamente registrados no Conselho Regional da área.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Gestão de Bancos de Dados : Criação, manutenção, atualização e migração de bancos de dados utilizados como base de conhecimento.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento de Campo : Análise contínua dos dados de intervenções de poços para organização e disponibilização estruturada das informações, desenvolvimento de análises para identificar correlações entre dados relevantes para planejamento e avaliação de riscos e avaliação de anormalidades nas intervenções, visando identificar tendências relacionadas à fase executada, à formação perfurada e às condições operacionais.
  • Análise técnica da informação preenchida no ou outro sistema adotado : Análise das intervenções, comunicação de divergências e garantia de convergência das informações e solicitação para implementação de alterações no banco de dados.
  • Controle de Qualidade das Bases de Dados dos Boletins de Intervenções em Poços: Utilização de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial e Business Intelligence para validação de dados, registro e manutenção da estruturação, taxonomia e ontologia dos dados e proposição de ajustes nos padrões e manuais.
  • Base Estatística dos Tempos das Operações: Criação e manutenção da base de dados históricos para análise da duração das operações, diferenciando tempos úteis e perdidos para composição de distribuições probabilísticas.
  • Apoio ao Planejamento de Intervenções: Organização e validação de informações para planejamento de intervenções futuras, análise de insumos, verificação da completude e validação das datas de início fim do estudo, simulação de duração das operações utilizando software específico e elaboração de relatórios conforme padrões estabelecidos e validados.
  • Análise Semestral e Plurianual de Controle de Processo : Avaliação da evolução temporal das operações e identificação de tendências para aprimoramento do processo.
  • Análise Específica: Estudo detalhado das características, tempos e anomalias das operações para identificação de padrões, correlações e tendências para um determinado período, campo ou bacia, podendo envolver dados internos ou externos.
  • Acompanhamento de Campanhas: Monitoramento do progresso das campanhas, atualização de projeções e análise de desvios em relação ao planejamento.
  • Desempenho de Operações Submarinas : Medidas de duração das operações submarinas segmentadas conforme a ontologia estabelecida e comparativo de desempenho entre prestadores de serviços, incluindo análises gráficas (boxplots).
  • Planejamento de Campanhas : Uso da base de conhecimento operacional para estimativas de duração, planejamento e análise técnico-econômica das campanhas.

Atividades Complementares:

  • Análise, suporte, revisão e elaboração de documentos técnicos;
  • Levantamento, tratamento e consolidação de dados;
  • Estudos comparativos de estimativas de duração;
  • Suporte técnico em governança de grupos temáticos e revisão de procedimentos técnicos;
  • Planejamento e acompanhamento de ações de pesquisa e desenvolvimento;
  • Avaliação de viabilidade técnica e econômica de tecnologias;
  • Atualização de configurações de poços em bases de dados;
  • Solicitação de orçamentação para estimativas de duração, quando necessário;
  • Alimentação de bases de dados externas com informações obtidas nas bases de dados;
  • Solicitação de acesso aos aplicativos e sistemas utilizados para execução dos serviços contratados.

title: Manager, FP&A LATAM Topline - Stills
description:
You will be part of the LATAM OU FP&A Service Delivery team of 20 Company associates, as an individual contributor, but working with a team of Genpact Associates that delivers all Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities related to still business in LATAM.

LATAM is one of the largest Operations globally, with nearly 10B Unit Cases, $ 6.5B NSR and $ 4B OI, and is also a highly complex operating unit, with several unique business models (+50).

You will support and partner with the Operating Unit Stills Finance Director and his direct team in management of the profit & value sharing agreements with the Brazil bottlers with focus on the Stills portfolio (non-carbonated drinks, as Water, Juices, Teas, Sport drinks, Protein and Dairy) and Stills processes (Actuals, ABP, RE, Conciliation, ad-hoc analysis), while ensuring quality and timeliness.

The role also provides the opportunity to shape the future support model and processes to drive accuracy & timeliness of information to support the OU Finance team and interactions with the bottler through better insights and financial analysis to enable business decisions.

What You\'ll Do for Us

  • Geographic scope: LATAM.
  • Collaborates and fosters relationships with LATAM operating unit and other hubs within Finance Hub to execute strategic initiatives and support on operational deliverables.
  • Deliver monthly financial analysis and create working files to support it (unique financial database, templates / working files to be used, financial analysis, consolidated view, presentation / delivery deck).
  • Proposes & implements process improvement opportunities to improve Stills processes deliverables quality and timeliness including automation and data visualization.
  • Translates data into insights: ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret various type of data related to profit sharing model.
  • Ensures quality of information provided to stakeholders through validations, consistency & review routines related to our Genpact partners.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • 3-5 years of related work experience in Commercial Finance (Stills knowledge will be a plus), Financial Planning and Analysis, Process Improvement and Project Management.
  • Advanced English.
  • Experience in business planning, financial planning, and reporting, involving influencing, communicating effectively, and managing the business needs across a varied group of business stakeholders.
  • Experience in other business functions and field operation will be a plus.
  • Experiencein virtual management across cultures and time zones is a plus.
  • Experience in a multinational with a global footprint.
  • Strong demonstration of business acumen, financial competency, global mindset, effective communication, systems proficiency, change adaptability, flexibility, being able to operate in ambiguous situations, business partnership and collaboration, and innovation.
  • Advanced communication and influence skills in the context of both external business partners (our bottlers) and internal leadership.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Tools and Power BI.

Functional Skills

  • Experience in various domains of FP&A -especially Topline, including Volume, Pricing, sparkling, still business models andsystem economics.

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de quatro (a) Engenheiros (Sênior) para atuar na Gerência de Estruturação de Dados Técnicos para o BPR e RTP do Sistema de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica da companhia, com foco em assegurar a consistência dos dados técnicos e regulatórios no âmbito da revisão do BPR e da RTP, a qual é fundamental para garantir os retornos dos investimentos realizados pela companhia sob responsabilidade da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia e Expansão (VEE).

Este(a) profissional será responsável por coordenar os levantamentos dos dados técnicos e memórias de cálculos para os projetos de reforços e melhorias que irão subsidiar a revisão do Banco de Preços de Referência e a Revisão Tarifária Periódica, avaliando critérios técnicos, regulatórios e econômico-financeiros, de forma a subsidiar a correta alocação e garantir os objetivos corporativos da Axia Energia.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar dados técnicos contratuais referentes aos equipamentos por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais.
  • Levantar dados contratuais EPCISTA’s identificando as aberturas de canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos por módulos (UAR, COM e CA) por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais direcionadas corretamente para cada item da EAP.
  • Analisar os desvios encontrados entre os valores realizados nos projetos em cada sub-pep, com cruzamento dessas informações com as previsões constantes dos atos regulatórios.
  • Identificar as possíveis necessidades de cadastros no SGPMR/O.N.S, quando não previstas no projeto inicial, e após terem sido confirmadas pela regulação e classificadas como item extrapatrimonial, e encaminhar o levantamento para a área responsável na engenharia por esses cadastros.
  • Atuar de forma efetiva no levantamento dos dados técnicos necessários para garantir o reconhecimento dos investimentos em Transmissão pela nossa empresa, integrando dados técnicos, atos regulatórios e valores realizados no SAP.
  • Enviar as memórias de cálculo para as bases de regulação por empresa (AXIA Energia, AXIA Energia Nordeste, AXIA Energia Norte e AXIA Energia Sul).
  • Fornecer informações para o acompanhamento das alocações (MOP-Cat2 e outros contratos de suporte) nos PEP, garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade pelas rubricas canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Engenharia, preferencialmente elétrica e civil.
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em empresas do setor elétrico, especialmente em planejamento, implantação de obras de reforços e melhorias de transmissão.
  • Conhecimento dos procedimentos e normativos da ANEEL e do ONS relacionados a reforços e melhorias (Módulo 2 dos Procedimentos de Rede, REN 905/2020 e correlatas).
  • Conhecimento do Módulo 9: Concessionárias de Transmissão Submódulo 9.1 REVISÃO PERIÓDICA DAS RECEITAS DAS CONCESSIONÁRIAS DE TRANSMISSÃO
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e análise de portfólio e projetos (Excel avançado, SAP, Power BI, MS Project).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de interação com diferentes áreas técnicas e níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de portfólio e projetos (PMI, Stage-Gate, Lean Project Management).
  • Experiência prévia em empresas transmissoras ou no ONS/ANEEL será considerado diferencial relevante.

Banco de Talentos Diversos - Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência

Rio de Janeiro; São Paulo

VTEX é a plataforma de comércio completa que proporciona mais eficiência e menos manutenção para organizações que buscam fazer investimentos mais inteligentes em TI e modernizar sua estrutura de tecnologia. Através da nossa abordagem pragmática, capacitamos marcas, distribuidores e varejistas com uma flexibilidade incomparável e soluções abrangentes, permitindo que invistam apenas no que oferece uma vantagem clara para o negócio e aumenta a lucratividade.

A VTEX é confiada por 2.400 clientes globais B2C e B2B, incluindo Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker e Whirlpool, operando 3.400 lojas online ativas em 43 países (dados do ano fiscal encerrado em 31 de dezembro de 2024).

Fundada no ano 2000, a VTEX tem uma trajetória de crescimento imbatível. Desafiando todas as probabilidades, estamos liderando a indústria de alta tecnologia e nos posicionando acima de gigantes do mercado. Estamos construindo um futuro extraordinário com mais de 1.300 colaboradores distribuídos por 25 localidades em 16 países da América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia. Para mais informações, visite

Na VTEX, você trabalhará em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, colaborando com colegas incríveis. Se você tem força individual, junte-se a nós e, juntos, seremos imparáveis.

INCLUSÃO E ACESSIBILIDADE

Na VTEX, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que a inclusão é essencial para o nosso sucesso. Esta vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) como parte do nosso compromisso em promover um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. Acreditamos na geração de oportunidades como ferramenta de mudança e estamos focados em encontrar talentos diversos para nossos times! Estamos comprometidos em adaptar nossas instalações e ferramentas para garantir a acessibilidade de todos os nossos colaboradores, bem como dos candidatos do processo seletivo. Se você precisar de alguma adequação especial para participar do nosso processo seletivo, por favor, nos informe.

Principais áreas que recrutamos:

Essa é nosso banco de talentos de Diversidade, focado em Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência. Nosso time de Recrutamento está constantemente revisando os currículos que chegarem por aqui, e quando identificamos uma ótima oportunidade, entramos em contato com as pessoas para que elas participem do nosso processo de recrutamento.

Quem pode se inscrever?

Todas as pessoas com deficiência podem se inscrever nessa página e em qualquer outra vaga na nossa página de carreiras. Aqui, seu perfil será revisado e, se houver compatibilidade, encaminhado para áreas nas quais estamos contratando. Caso você não se identifique como uma pessoa com deficiência, confira nossas outras oportunidades na página de carreiras da VTEX.

  • Programa anual de participação nos lucros e elegibilidade para ações
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida com cobertura nacional fornecido pela VTEX
  • Programa de incentivo ao desenvolvimento de idiomas (Inglês, Espanhol, Português)
  • Vale-refeição flexível
  • Licenças parentais estendidas
  • Horário de trabalho flexível e cultura de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência financeira para montar sua estação de trabalho em casa
  • Frete grátis em mais de 1.000 lojas clientes da VTEX

A VTEX coleta dados pessoais sobre você conforme necessário para fins de solicitação, avaliação e seleção de candidatos para emprego. description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Position Title

Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Social Work

Appointment Type

Full-Time, Tenure-Track

Department

Social Work

Reports To

Dean, School of Social Work

Position Summary

The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. The position emphasizes high-quality teaching, the development and/or maintenance of a sustainable research agenda, and meaningful contributions to service within the school, university, profession, and community.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Teaching and Instruction

  • Teach graduate social work courses to include use of appropriate technologies
  • Use inclusive, student-centered instructional strategies
  • Participate in curriculum development and assessment
  • Mentor MSW and PhD students

Research and Scholarship

  • Develop and/or execute a focused scholarly research agenda
  • Produce peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations
  • Pursue funding opportunities to support research and scholarship

Service

  • Participate in school and institutional service
  • Engage in professional and community service activities

Required Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or DSW) in Social Work or related field by time of appointment
  • MSW from a CSWE-accredited program
  • Demonstrated ability or potential for effective teaching, research, and scholarship that aligns with the school’s needs, mission, vision, and guiding philosophy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent teaching evaluations and experience teaching online
  • At least two years post-MSW practice experience and social work licensure
  • Applicants for associate and full professor ranks must have a record of funded research

Application Process

For consideration, submit a letter of interest outlining research, teaching, service, and practice experiences along with a curriculum vita and two samples of scholarly work. Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $80,000 - $110,000

title: Transmission Manager
description:
The Role

What is the role?

You will be part of a team supporting renewable development efforts. Primarily your responsibilities will be to execute studies evaluating and assessing the feasibility of renewable power and/or energy storage projects.

You will also:

  • Provide a strategic view on grid connections for future projects
  • Setup and maintain models required for performing in-house studies typically focused on renewable power and/or energy storage projects
  • Gather power system data and maintain internal databases for use in power system studies in focus areas
  • Monitor changes to power systems (e.g., new generation, generation retirements, transmission upgrades, new demand, energy efficiency programs, demand response programs), gather associated data and update simulation databases as needed
  • Prepare inputs for studies
  • Perform simulations under managerial supervision
  • Gather, analyze and summarize results of simulations. The latter may involve writing reports, preparing and delivering presentation, preparing excel spreadsheets, etc.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant grid codes
  • Team player, working with the team, as well as the larger organization
  • Assist with similar tasks in other regions of the world
  • Assist/coordinate the work of outside consultants

What we need from you

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer.
  • Bachelor's Degree in electrical engineering or other relevant discipline preferred. Master Degree or PhD preferred
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Additional experience preferred
  • Several years of experience with transmission planning models such as PSS/E, PSLF, DIgSILENT, ETAP, Aspen
  • Experience within, or working with relevant functions at the ISO/RTO/TP/TNO/DNO level
  • Experience with MV and HV work; substation engineering
  • Significant experience with power system modeling methods such as demand forecasting, security constrained economic dispatch (SCED), security constrained unit commitment (SCUC), power flow, optimal power flow
  • Proficient in preparation of technical reports and technical presentations
  • Strong collaboration and problem-solving skills, capable of applying advanced power systems engineering principles to identify and solve complex issues
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships within a complex, global corporation: some corporate stamina is required
  • Reports to the Global Head of Transmission Strategy
  • Availability to travel 20% of the time primarily domestic travel
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages a plus
  • Kindly submit your resume in both Portuguese and English.

Potential Location(s) for Resourcing: Sao Paulo, Rio or virtual.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

O CEL tem como missão proporcionar uma educação global de excelência, norteada por valores humanos, contribuindo para formar cidadãos íntegros e capazes de realizar as suas potencialidades.

Estamos buscando um Orientador Educacional protagonista para ajudar os alunos a se prepararem para o aproveitamento acadêmico, desenvolver o projeto de vida e competências pessoais ou sociais.

Tais projetos visam, primordialmente, ao sucesso acadêmico através de estímulo ao potencial de cada aluno, ao seu bem-estar social, à valorização de suas habilidades e aptidões e ao desenvolvimento de valores essenciais à realização de uma vida plena.

  • Planejar, em conjunto com a Coordenação Geral, as reuniões com os pais/responsáveis;
  • Planejar e desenvolver o processo de eleição de alunos representantes de turma;
  • Realizar reuniões com os alunos representantes das turmas;

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping build and scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be an early builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.
