title: Ai Automation Specialist
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You’ll Do Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines. Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments. Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines. Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production. Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head. Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately. Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask. Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time. Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred). Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs. Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures. Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations. Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding. A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs. A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it. Bonus Points Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.). Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts). Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description: Descrição da Vaga (JD): O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar: ▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. ▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação. ▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações. ▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada. ▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações. ▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM). ▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação. ▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM. ▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio. ▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas. ▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders. ▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint. ▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Advogado(A) Sr.
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. title: Engineer Manager
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). title: Support Specialist
description: At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip! About the opportunity As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F. This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities: Troubleshooting & Problem Solving Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues. Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices. Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video. Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner. Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs. Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems. Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem. Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications: Technical Expertise: Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications. Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components. Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools. Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems. Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience: Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies. Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS). Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications: Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms. Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip Passion for helping others internally and externally Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Capacidade analítica,autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;

Sobre a Agropalma A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Analista De Infraestrutura De Redes Pleno
description: Este curso de diploma discute os fundamentos de redes e redes locais (LANs). Apresentamos a terminologia de redes e explicamos a transferência serial de dados e endereços de protocolo de internet (IP) enquanto analisamos os tipos mais comuns de rede. Estudamos o modelo de 'interconexão de sistemas abertos' (OSI) para ilustrar como suas camadas orientam o fluxo do tráfego de rede. Abordamos redes cabeadas e sem fio, além das ferramentas usadas para gerenciar e solucionar problemas nelas. O protocolo de configuração dinâmica de host (DHCP) é um protocolo cliente/servidor que permite que computadores clientes configurados obtenham endereços IP automaticamente. Destacamos quais informações podem ser obtidas dos endereços IP usando DHCP e os benefícios disso. Em seguida, investigamos o processo de descoberta ‘discovery, offer, request, acknowledge’ (DORA) e o 'endereçamento IP privado automático' (APIPA), que é um serviço para atribuir endereços IP únicos a redes pequenas de escritório ou domésticas sem a necessidade de implantar o serviço DHCP. Configurar uma rede pode ajudar uma empresa a aproveitar ao máximo seus sistemas e equipamentos de computação. É uma maneira rápida e confiável de compartilhar informações e recursos. Este curso oferece um entendimento profundo dos diferentes tipos de LANs e WANs encontrados em redes, bem como dos protocolos usados para garantir comunicações seguras e preservar a segurança da rede. Este diploma é adequado para quem trabalha na área de tecnologia da informação, portanto inscreva-se para aprimorar suas habilidades em computação e dar o próximo passo na sua carreira.

title: Web Content Editor / Web Qa (Growth Role)
description: Location: Brazil Team: Digital / Web Company Description Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail. Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: 1398 - Estagiário Cursando Administração De Empresas Ou Contabilidade
description: A função administrativa dentro de uma organização é fundamental para muitas atividades empresariais mais amplas e requer habilidades especializadas para desempenho ideal e contribuição para o sucesso do negócio. Neste Diploma online gratuito em Administração de Empresas, você aprenderá alguns dos equipamentos básicos e competências necessárias para ser um administrador de negócios em um ambiente de atendimento ao cliente. Os sistemas telefônicos estão se tornando cada vez mais sofisticados e este curso gratuito de gestão empresarial aborda algumas das principais funcionalidades de diferentes sistemas telefônicos, bem como como fazer, receber e transferir chamadas para manter uma boa comunicação. Você também analisará a importância da comunicação verbal e não verbal. As operações comerciais são então analisadas, incluindo os processos em que você pode estar envolvido e como trabalhar em equipe com diferentes tipos de pessoas, o que traz seus próprios desafios. Esta certificação em administração empresarial discutirá as funções administrativas essenciais e o papel da tecnologia no cumprimento dessas funções. Você aprenderá o propósito do presidente em uma reunião, suas responsabilidades formais e os arranjos e ações do administrador de negócios, que incluem planejamento e organização de reuniões, bem como ações de acompanhamento. O conteúdo do curso aborda viagens empresariais, como obter informações relacionadas a viagens, políticas de viagens de negócios e como manter-se dentro do orçamento. Um bom atendimento ao cliente é outra parte importante das operações comerciais e este curso ensinará como lidar com questões dos clientes, como tratar o cliente, como usar o conhecimento e expertise do produto para oferecer um atendimento personalizando, assim como como atender às expectativas de clientes e consumidores. O conteúdo discutido neste curso de gestão administrativa abrange diretrizes específicas da empresa conforme a situação, integração, treinamento e atualizações em comunicações corporativas. O conteúdo explorado inclui qualidade de produtos e serviços e como manter altos padrões evita perdas e reclamações dos clientes. Na última parte deste curso, a produção de documentos de alta qualidade é discutida em detalhes junto com diferentes tipos de documentos e processos em que você pode estar envolvido, além dos benefícios de usar tecnologias de suporte como o Microsoft (MS) Office. Se você quer aprender habilidades abrangentes e eficazes de administração de empresas e é um estudante buscando novas competências ou um profissional administrativo querendo aperfeiçoar suas capacidades, então comece o Diploma em Administração de Empresas hoje mesmo.

Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations. Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products. Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes. Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies. Document processes, configurations, and migration steps;
deliver clear communication to stakeholders. Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments. IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience. TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management. JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language. REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts. System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required. Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects. NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product. Preferred Skills and Proficiencies: Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation. Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes. Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance. Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space. Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente. Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país! O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação! O que você deve ter? Requisitos Responsabilidades Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de software alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e às diretrizes organizacionais;
Desenvolver soluções técnicas que atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, desempenho e segurança;
Atuar como referência técnica em projetos, colaborando com equipes de engenharia e produto;
Garantir a qualidade docódigo e a integridade das soluções, apoiando revisões e boas práticas;
Utilizar ferramentas deautomação e CI/CD para assegurar integridade e performance dos sistemas;
Analisar arquiteturas de sistemas e processos existentes, identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias;
Documentar arquiteturasutilizando padrões reconhecidos (ex. C4) e disseminar boas práticas entre times;
Conduzir discussões técnicas e apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica junto a stakeholders de tecnologia. Requisitos Técnicos Domínio de arquiteturas de software avançadas, incluindo microserviços, serverless e monólitos modulares;
Experiência sólida em desenho de soluções escaláveis, seguras e resilientes;
Vivência prática com ferramentas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
Capacidade de atuação em equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo colaboração e qualidade técnica;
Visão sistêmica sobre impacto de decisões arquiteturais em ambientes de TI complexos. Espanhol avançado (obrigatório), para atuação direta com stakeholders e clientes LATAM. Diferenciais Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem em pelo menos um dos principais provedores (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
Conhecimento em padrõesde documentação arquitetural, como C4;
Experiência em consultoria, atuando em múltiplos contextos e clientes;
Inglês avançado, para interação em projetos internacionais. Espanhol avançado O que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas: - Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos! - Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.
- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio. E os benefícios? Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina,Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais! Como é trabalhar na BRQ? Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista De P&D - Android Embarcado

title: Principal Data Engineer
description: About The Product At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business. Key Responsibilities: Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack Elevate engineering excellence Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets Qualifications Technical Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP) Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent) Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines Experience with workflow orchestration (e.G., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer) Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks Performance and cost optimization in cloud title: Head Of Artificial Intelligence
description:
A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Estamos construindo a próxima geração de software financeiro — com forte uso de IA aplicada a problemas reais, complexos e críticos. Buscamos alguém para liderar essa evolução do ponto de vista técnico. O desafio Você será responsável por desenhar e liderar a construção de sistemas de decisão baseados em IA aplicados ao contexto financeiro. Isso inclui desde interpretação de dados não estruturados até automação de fluxos críticos com alto nível de confiabilidade. Essa não é uma vaga para trabalhar com IA. É uma vaga para construir sistemas que tomam decisões reais em produção. perfeição) Diferenciais Experiência com dados financeiros ou sistemas críticos Já construiu sistemas com alto requisito de confiabilidade Experiência com avaliação e melhoria contínua de modelos Consegue explicar trade-offs técnicos de forma clara O que não buscamos Perfis focados apenas em prompt engineering Experiência apenas acadêmica ou experimental Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção Remuneração Contrato PJ Faixa: R$ 35k – R$ 45k/mês Processo Conversa inicial Entrevista técnica Case prático

title: Program Coordinator
description: About Sofia Health Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we're making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses. Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more. In this role, you'll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building. Responsibilities Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.G., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs) Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery Requirements 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools Strong written and verbal communication skills Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness Ability to work independently in a remote environment Bonus Points Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints. Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team's single point of accountability for quality and progress. Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners. Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications. Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests. Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live. Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams. Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues. Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers. Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB). Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities. Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives. Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions. Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation. Qualifications Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking. Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues. Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams. Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. title: Analista De Geracao De Demanda Ti Ii
description: A gestão de projetos de construção é considerada uma das tarefas mais difíceis e complexas atualmente, devido à expansão do setor, sua crescente influência nas economias dos países e o enorme progresso tecnológico envolvido. A gestão eficaz dos custos desses projetos é fundamental para o seu sucesso, e as estatísticas não indicam números promissores quanto à porcentagem de projetos que conseguem alcançar seus objetivos sem ultrapassar os orçamentos. Por isso, a qualidade na gestão dos custos desse tipo de projeto tornou-se uma das principais habilidades exigidas no mercado de trabalho. Este curso oferece aos alunos os conhecimentos básicos e habilidades avançadas para gerenciar os custos em projetos de construção. Ele começa com uma introdução à indústria da construção, seu desenvolvimento, desafios, custos, gestão, conceitos, tipos e sistemas. O curso então aborda o plano de gestão dos custos do projeto por meio de liderança de custos, elementos de custos, monitoramento e controle, e áreas específicas para foco. Conclui com as melhores práticas para planos de implementação eficazes, perigos potenciais, desafios e uma receita modelo para um plano de ação efetivo. O curso cobre todo o ciclo de vida do projeto. Neste curso, você será guiado cuidadosamente para entender e se destacar na gestão de custos na construção. Ao final, você irá compreender como dominar a gestão de custos em projetos de construção e como pode contribuir para o sucesso deles. Não espere mais e inscreva-se agora.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.Js
description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn. The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software! Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn. Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status. Responsibilities Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js Develop and implement highly responsive UI components Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications Monitor and improve end-to-end performance Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems Required Experience Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software A focus on customer value delivery Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake Desired Experience University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field Additional Information Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays Start: ASAP Core Client Values The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture. Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses. About Velozient We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132

validated implementation.At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).Nice-to-Have:Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.Evaluation Process:Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round.Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements.After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. title: Electrical Engineer
description:

Advanced English;
Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;
Strong analytical andproblem-solving skills;
Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;
Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work. Nice to have Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems. Benefits Meal and food allowances Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay) Life Insurance Annual Bonus Private Pension Plan Childcare Allowance Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens. title: Arquiteto De Soluções Plm (Teamcentrer) - Sênior
description: Este curso online gratuito afirma que a energia solar, que é renovável e obtida pelo uso da radiação eletromagnética do Sol, é suficiente para suprir as necessidades energéticas do mundo. Investigamos como a radiação solar chega à Terra e como tem sido utilizada pelos humanos ao longo do tempo por meio de tecnologias em constante evolução. Explicamos como a energia do Sol pode ser coletada por células fotoelétricas, heliostatos ou coletores solares antes de ser transformada em energia elétrica ou térmica, potencialmente solucionando alguns dos problemas energéticos globais. Este curso explora esse potencial enquanto estudamos o que acontece com o Sol, sua radiação e como ela se relaciona com a Terra por meio de uma ampla variedade de fenômenos ligados à absorção e liberação da energia solar. Em seguida, abordamos a importância de manter um delicado equilíbrio de CO2 na atmosfera e como o aumento das emissões pode prejudicar a humanidade e o meio ambiente. Analisamos como a captação de energia solar pode ser afetada pela localização geográfica, estação do ano e horário do dia. O curso detalha os espectros eletromagnético, solar e visível, antes de mergulhar na relação entre a temperatura da Terra, a radiação de corpo negro e o comprimento de onda. O curso examina então o uso e as características de uma célula solar baseada na junção p-n, a estrutura fundamental dos semicondutores. Exploramos a construção e eficiência de diferentes tipos de células solares, incluindo as células 'tandem' que podem ser conectadas em série para aumentar a eficiência geral da célula fotovoltaica. Discutimos as vantagens da produção de hidrogênio e da divisão fotocatalítica da água em relação à eletrólise. O curso avança para a recombinação de lacunas de elétrons, fotocatalisadores que convertem energia solar em energia química na superfície de um catalisador ou substrato, composto por material semicondutor que acelera a velocidade das reações. Este curso é voltado para quem deseja aprender mais sobre energia solar e as oportunidades que ela oferece como fonte limpa de energia. Também é adequado para profissionais do setor energético que buscam melhorar processos e o desempenho de equipamentos ao explorar formas inovadoras de aproveitar o incrível poder do Sol.
